adopt: Turn a failure into a filed, redacted GitHub issue that collapses into the duplicate when one exists.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A bug report is the artifact most likely to carry a credential -- logs, a config dump, an env var someone exported to reproduce the fault -- and the person writing it is already frustrated and will not read it twice. So the secret ships, or the report never gets filed at all.

Install
builds in-tree (AitherOS/packages/awreport) -- not on PyPI yet; `pip install awreport` 404s today
synopsis: File a bug report that has already scrubbed your secrets and collapsed the duplicate.
